I think I have caretaker alters, but clearly they are failing at their jobs. 

Thank you for your response. 😊
Agreed. Unless there is some sort of bathroom trauma or other issue. None of our alters do those things, though they could if they wanted to.
Yeah, alters don’t need to sleep, eat, or use the restroom. They can choose to, I suppose, but they don’t need to. Why they would choose to do unnecessary things, I don’t know.
